title: LuV era
note: LuV era per docs/eras/luv.md ("Validator (-Tier luv)", "Gate to ZPM", "Only from there, and the cuts", "Automatic resource generation"), in seven substages: luv (home: the cryogenics, mode 2, the magnet works, the biofoundry, the Mk1 and research), luv-orbit (the first station in Earth orbit), luv-belt (the asteroid belt, and the way to the Jovian moons, crafted after it), luv-io, then luv-europa and luv-ganymede (siblings: one level 4 trip reaches them all, but Europa's bases are Io's sulfur concrete, docs/eras/luv.md, so Io comes first) and luv-io-orbit (the second station, or the sulfur-iodine plant on Io). Dimension ids come from the pack's tables (tables/orbits.json and tables/places.json, lib/places.mjs tokens), never hard-coded. The era is built in packages (A1-A5, B1-B10): `packages` says what the dump must carry for each to count as landed, and every target of a package that hasn't landed warns instead of failing (lib/packages.mjs), so the config already holds the whole design. Our generator types are EU sources into the wireless network (synthetic recipesOf: orbital_solar, volcanic_heat, electrodynamic_tether, and GT--'s reactor III); the network's LuV tier is the synthetic wireless-luv (a tower with LuV SMES cells). Two IV hatches give LuV voltage (the two-hatch rule; wireless hatches count, S0-10), so mode 2 and every LuV multiblock of ours run before the LuV energy hatch. The Mk1's start is capped at 160 M EU (conditions.eu_to_start).

world.note: The first landing on the belt (Bridges and first landings): raw meteoric iron (the M-type sample) and 2 ores of each vein the harpoon drill's table offers (veins_belt.json), by hand once.
Io's ground: brimstone (the Ionian seed's local input), brimstone fumaroles (Io's surface rules; the condenser's field), black sand and basalt (sulfur concrete), magma (the intake's patera).
Europa's ice: blue ice is the Europan seed's local input; the cryobot's shaft is packed or blue ice.
Ganymede's tuff (the seed's local input) and packed ice (the GW detector's buried arms).

machines.note: Helium refrigerator (A3, Earth): GTM's helium-cooled hot ingots in a closed loop (25 mB make-up). 1-2 energy hatches: two IV hatches give LuV voltage.
Coated conductor line (A3, Earth): c1 Ni-W substrate (Mars tungsten), c2 ITBTC tape at 30,720 EU/t.

HTS magnet works (A4, Earth): c1 HTS coil (144 mB trinium), c2 the LuV SMES cell, c3 coilgun coil casings, c4 magnetic bearings (the belt's tetrataenite); a 1,000 mB liquid helium charge, never used up.
Biofoundry (A5, Earth): GTM's sterile chain composed under its own type, c1-c10: collagen, gelatin, agar, then from bacteria (Europa, B8) sludge, mutagen, medium, stem cells and the engineered seeds.
Microgravity smelter (B3, any orbit): c1 ZBLAN optical pipes, c2 Whipple shield casing, c3 containerless naquadah alloy. Every recipe carries G.orbits.allow.
Wake shield facility (B3, any orbit): UHPIC and HPIC wafers, triple-junction wafers (Io's germanium); its disc is Whipple shield casing.
Zero-g crystal grower (B4, any orbit): raw crystal chips (olivine or emerald with europium, or the parts with europium, bacterial sludge or mutagen) and the sapphire test mass.

Rotating hydroponic ring (B4, any orbit; greenhouse step 4): only its own greenhouse/luv/* recipes (its modifier): the neurotrophic factor and plant collagen. Its hub carries magnetic bearings (the belt's tetrataenite).
Organoid lab (B4, any orbit): c1 neural organoid (stem cells, the factor), c2 the neuro processing unit at 30,720 EU/t.
Orbital solar station (B2, Earth orbit): a generator of its own type, 630 EU/t a lit panel, always on in orbit; its EU is the synthetic orbital-solar.
Harpoon anchor drill (B5, belt; vein drill step 7a): only vein_drilling/luv/harpoon_* (the family veto and its prefix), the HSS-S bit and harpoons.
Asteroid processor (B5, anywhere): c1 Mond (the only PGM concentrate), c2 magnetic split (tetrataenite).
Optical miner (B5, belt): c1 a capture bag -> water, CO2, carbon and the only chondritic extract; c2 Boudouard CO.
Fumarole condenser (B6, Io): c1 collect, c2 separate (the only germanium), c3 sulfur concrete.
Volcanic intake (B6, Io): a generator of its own type on an SO2 charge; its EU is the synthetic volcanic-heat.
Flux-tube tether (B7, Io orbit, if spike S0-3 holds): a generator of its own type; its EU is the synthetic tether.
Sulfur-iodine plant (B7's fallback, Io): hydrogen and oxygen from Io's heat.
Cryobot (B8, Europa; vein drill step 7b): only vein_drilling/luv/cryobot_* (the family veto and its prefix): the ocean sample and the brine.
Algae bioreactor (B8; greenhouse step 5): c1 algae anywhere, c2 the Europan culture on Europa: the only bacteria.
Gravitational-wave detector (B9, Ganymede; observatory step 6): the catalogue.
Coilgun probe launcher (B9, Ganymede): the Jovian survey and the Saturn chart.

GT--'s circuit assembly line (GTPPMachines.kt: a single energy hatch cell) on one LuV hatch: A5 re-registers its wetware processor at 30,720 EU/t (grindless:circuit_assembly_line/*); GTM refuses anything above the hatch's tier, so GTM's NPU (80,000 EU/t) never runs here. Its casings are GT--'s and not modeled.

Our Universal Assembly Factory (mv/leisure_factories.js) on two LuV hatches: ZPM voltage by GTM's rule, but its modifier refuses GTM's NPU unless one hatch alone reaches ZPM (HATCH_VOLTAGE_LOCKED, LuV-A5).

GTM's Fusion Reactor Mk1 (B10, Earth): LuV recipes (FusionReactorMachine.java:185) with a start up to 160 M EU (conditions.eu_to_start); fusion casings (a superconducting coil and a neutron reflector each), HTS coils (A4's magnet works) and 15-16 LuV energy hatches.

GT--'s naquadah reactor III (32,768 EU/t, a long enriched naquadah rod per 30,516 t): a single-block generator; its EU is the synthetic naquadah-reactor and its spent rod goes back to mode 2, circuit 3.
GTM's HPCA (B10, the gate): computer casings, computation components, a transmitter hatch to the research station. Computation (CWU) is capital: formed once.
GTM's research station (B10): writes the data orb of the ZPM energy hatch (research:<id>), fed by the HPCA's computation.

synthetic.note: The first station (Route step 4): GCYR's packager and package launched on the tier 3 rocket to Earth orbit (tables/orbits.json `earth`), and the suit's freeze protection (a second pass of the thermal template with insulating fabric, spike S0-8). GT machines are built after arrival. B1 makes the keycard and the place rules; the trip itself is GCYR's and already in the dump.

The level 4 rocket (Route step 5, B1): elite motors and only cryogenic tanks (grindless:cryogenic_fuel_tank, id final after S0-2). One rocket reaches the belt and the three moons (tables/places.json): the moons are sibling substages, the belt comes first in eraOrder (the culture needs its extract).
The second station (B7, if spike S0-3 holds): a package launched to Io orbit (tables/orbits.json, the orbit of places.json `io`).

The network's LuV tier (A4): it outputs LuV only when every formed tower holds LuV SMES cells (the magnet works' circuit 2). wireless:luv is the gate's "network at LuV". Amperage and the 5 % entry loss aren't modeled.
The orbital solar station's EU (B2): sunlight in Earth orbit, no night; into the network (40,320 EU/t for 64 panels).
The volcanic intake's EU (B6): Io's heat on an SO2 charge, only on Io; up to 131,072 EU/t into the network.
The flux-tube tether's EU (B7): Jupiter's spin, only in Io orbit; a spool and argon.
GT--'s naquadah reactor III (the config only lists the LuV reactor): a long enriched naquadah rod (mode 2's sulfate) a run.
